verified_facts.text: The hotel sits on the heights of Gustavia, overlooking Shell Beach.
verified_facts.excerpt: Nestled on the heights of Gustavia, overlooking the iconic Shell Beach

verified_facts.text: Barrière markets the hotel under the name Fouquet's Saint-Barth.
verified_facts.excerpt: # Fouquet's Saint-Barth Hotel

verified_facts.text: The suites were designed by Gilles & Boissier and have views of Gustavia and the Caribbean Sea.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Hotel's 21 Suites, designed by Gilles & Boissier boast sweeping views of Gustavia and the Caribbean Sea.

verified_facts.text: Each accommodation is Colonial-inspired and has an outdoor terrace, a private pool, or both.
verified_facts.excerpt: Each accommodation is Colonial-inspired and features an outdoor terrace and/or private pool.

verified_facts.text: Villa Diane has a private plunge pool perched atop the island with island views.
verified_facts.excerpt: and features a private plunge pool perched atop the island for the ultimate island views

verified_facts.text: Villa Diane is a villa on a hillside overlooking St Barths, between land and sea.
verified_facts.excerpt: There is no doubt this is a jewel of a villa nestled into a hillside overlooking the beautiful St Barths, between Caribbean land and sea.

verified_facts.text: A tailor-made Villa Diane offer includes private chef and butler services.
verified_facts.excerpt: Private Chef and Butler services

verified_facts.text: The Royal Loft has a roof terrace and sits at the top of the main house.
verified_facts.excerpt: The exceptional luxury of a roof terrace, reinvented in the “Royal Loft” style. An incomparable address at the heights of the island, located at the top of the main house.

verified_facts.text: The Suite Lucien Duplex has a roof terrace and a hot tub.
verified_facts.excerpt: The exceptional luxury of a roof terrace. The Suite Lucien Duplex Hot tub is as spacious as it is extraordinary.

verified_facts.text: The Deluxe Suite with pool and sea view has understated, pared-down decor with a few exotic touches, in the St Barths tradition.
verified_facts.excerpt: With its understated, pared down decor, and a few exotic touches, the Deluxe Suite pool & sea view fits in perfectly with the purest St Barths tradition

verified_facts.text: In the Junior Suite with pool and sea view, tropical fabric adorns the headboard.
verified_facts.excerpt: Tropical fabric adorns the headboard for moments out of time and exquisite dreams.

verified_facts.text: The spa operates in exclusive partnership with Biologique Recherche.
verified_facts.excerpt: indulge in a timeless escape at the Spa, in exclusive partnership with Biologique Recherche.

verified_facts.text: Spa treatments include personalized face and body rituals.
verified_facts.excerpt: Personalized face and body rituals

verified_facts.text: Access to the spa is included in a stay.
verified_facts.excerpt: Access to the Spa in Saint-Barth

verified_facts.text: There is a yoga studio, with indoor and beachfront sessions.
verified_facts.excerpt: Yoga studio (indoor and beachfront sessions)

verified_facts.text: Guests can explore St Barth through a personalized itinerary.
verified_facts.excerpt: Experience Saint Bart’s stunning beauty through a personalized itinerary.

verified_facts.text: Island experiences include catamaran trips, hikes and sunset yoga sessions.
verified_facts.excerpt: explore the island by catamaran. Take-in the island beauty on a hike or unwind during a sunset yoga session.

verified_facts.text: Listed experiences include a hike to Colombier.
verified_facts.excerpt: Hiking to Colombier

verified_facts.text: Shellona is the hotel's seaside restaurant, with a menu created by Greek executive chef Yiannis Kioroglou.
verified_facts.excerpt: Fouquet's Saint-Barth seaside restaurant, Shellona, is a must-visit on every trip to the island. The menu created by Executive Greek Chef Yiannis Kioroglou is healthy, tasty and generous

verified_facts.text: Beefbar combines meats such as Wagyu, Black Angus and Kobe with fresh seafood and plant-based dishes.
verified_facts.excerpt: Beefbar: A refined concept that combines exceptional meats (Wagyu, Black Angus, Kobe) with fresh seafood and plant-based creations in a sophisticated setting.

verified_facts.text: The bar at Beefbar is a sea-view spot to meet at sunset.
verified_facts.excerpt: The bar is the perfect place to meet when the sun sets each evening.

verified_facts.text: Cribs are available free of charge on request.
